question: Will Eric Barlow win the 2026 Wyoming Governor Republican primary election?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Republican Primary for Governor of Wyoming, scheduled to take place on August 18, 2026. Resolution will be based on the overall winner of the primary, including any potential second round or run-off.

If no 2026 Wyoming Gubernatorial Republican Primary takes place, this market will resolve to “Other.”

The resolution source for this market will be the first official announcement of the results from the Wyoming Republican Party; however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

evidence.excerpt: His campaign released polling results Tuesday showing him at 42% support, followed by Degenfelder at 19% and Bien at 14% — with 22% undecided — when people were asked who they would vote for if the election were held today. The landline and cellphone call poll was taken from 400 likely Republican primary election voters and with a margin of error of 4.9%, according to the Barlow campaign. His campaign has amassed 2,500 volunteers and contributions from nearly 2,000 individual Wyoming donors, with more than $1 million raised from in-state individuals, the statement says.

Following an extensive grassroots evaluation process, the Wyoming Republican Party officially announces its platform-alignment endorsements for the upcoming Republican Primary Election. During its meeting, the State Central Committee evaluated candidate records, platform fidelity, and core conservative principles. Based on these evaluations, the Party endorses the following candidates for statewide leadership: Governor: Brent Bien.

The Wyoming Republican Party has endorsed Brent Bien for governor. Bien doesn’t have previous political experience, but decided to run in 2022 in response to Gov. Mark Gordon’s lockdown measures. In that year’s primary, he took about 30% of the vote to Gordon’s nearly 62%. Bien is running on the GOP ticket against three others: Megan Degenfelder, Eric Barlow and Curt Blake.
